title: Thandege Thakka Maga
desc: Sathya is forced to marry a woman from a lower caste after his father's sudden death. He struggles to lead a happy marital life while dealing with certain problems.

title: Aparichita
desc: A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.

title: Badava Rascal
desc: Shankar, a young man, is kidnapped by a gang of thugs. In order to escape his predicament, he narrates his life story to make his abductors rethink their decision.

title: Naani
desc: Soon after moving into their new palatial house, a couple begins experiencing paranormal phenomena. An investigation leads them to the chilling story of the house's previous inhabitants.

title: Anna Bond
desc: Bond Ravi, a martial arts champion, and Meera, a documentary film-maker, fall in love with each other. However, she gets kidnapped by a drug lord, prompting Bond to spring into action.
